title: The Secrets of the Red Cliffs

scenes.text: Jack sets out to explore the mysterious Red Cliffs.
scenes.image_prompt: boy explorer standing near giant red cliffs in desert

scenes.text: Jack faces difficult climbing conditions but continues upward.
scenes.image_prompt: boy climbing steep red cliff with rope

scenes.text: He finds carvings and a hidden passage leading underground.
scenes.image_prompt: hidden cave entrance with ancient carvings in cliff

scenes.text: Jack deciphers symbols to unlock a secret chamber.
scenes.image_prompt: boy solving ancient puzzle door glowing inside cave

scenes.text: He discovers a medallion and realizes the importance of history.
scenes.image_prompt: glowing medallion on pedestal inside ancient chamber

story: Jack explores the Red Cliffs in search of a hidden chamber. Through determination and intelligence, he uncovers ancient secrets and learns the value of history.
